title: Open Throw Lane in Atlanta
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step into the world of axe throwing with us, where fun meets competition in Atlanta With expert guidance from professional axe throwers, you’ll learn to throw axes safely while enjoying a unique blend of camaraderie and skill. Engage in various games tailored for all levels, from beginners to seasoned pros, and take advantage of our innovative Axe Arcade for a twist on traditional throwing. Grab your friends, bring your favorite snacks, and enjoy craft beer from Schoolhouse Brewing right next door. Whether it's a team-building event or a casual hangout, we are your go-to destination for a thrilling axe-throwing experience.
